answer: Require every agent to lock a vested stake at the wharf where identities board: the stake is released only gradually, and any proven Sybil cluster forfeits the whole deposit. Reputation tracks the delta between promised and delivered work, rising only with verified completions and decaying with inactivity, so a fresh fake identity starts at the bottom and must pay real time and compute to climb. No shortcut reaches the zenith of trust: the stake and work history cannot be duplicated, so each extra fake account costs as much as a genuine one.
